name: SYN-Tracker
description: A retro sound and DAW music tracker studio featuring vintage sound chips (C64 SID, Game Boy DMG, NES 2A03, Mega Drive, Amiga Paula with 115 ST floppy disks and 10,547+ instruments), multi-channel sequencing, SYN-Editor waveform sampler, 3D Demoscene Visualizer Studio, and release Cover Designer with MP3 ID3 baking.
